title: Results check: 10 claims, 5 wrong
task: A draft report makes the numbered claims below. Decide for each claim whether it is correct as stated. Use only the numbers given.

claims.1: In a trial with 1000 patients per arm, 40 placebo patients and 30 drug patients had the event, so the drug cut the risk of the event by 25%.
claims.2: In the same trial, the absolute risk reduction was 1 percentage point, so the number needed to treat is 100.
claims.3: In the same trial, the drug group had 10 fewer events per 1000 patients, which is a 1% relative reduction.
claims.4: Group A had a mean of 50 (95% CI 46 to 54) and group B a mean of 55 (95% CI 51 to 59). Because the two intervals overlap, the difference between the groups cannot be significant at the 5% level.
claims.5: A test with 99% sensitivity and 99% specificity, used where 1 person in 1000 has the disease, has a positive predictive value of about 9%.
claims.6: Revenue fell 20% in 2024 and rose 20% in 2025, so it is back to its 2023 level.
claims.7: The result had p = 0.03, so there is a 3% probability that the null hypothesis is true.
claims.8: For the values 3, 7, 7, 10 and 40, the median is 7 and the mean is 13.4.
claims.9: Doubling the sample size halves the standard error of the mean.
claims.10: A correlation of r = -0.8 is stronger than a correlation of r = 0.6.
